title: 47 GOALS IN 49 GAMES, AND THE HAIRCUT THAT NEEDED AN APOLOGY
description:
In 2021 Ronaldo apologised to the mothers whose sons copied his 2002 hair.

R9 has two Ballon d'Or wins and a very busy business record. In 2002 he wore a shaved head with one long forelock, and he now calls it horrible. At that World Cup he scored eight goals, including both in the two-nil final against Germany. Golden Boot, and a haircut that needed explaining.

At Barcelona in 1996-97 he scored forty-seven goals in forty-nine games. His shooting was better than his hairstyling.

Then came the business years. He bought fifty-one per cent of Real Valladolid, which brought three relegations and two promotions. Cruzeiro: bought in December 2021, sold in April 2024.
